interfaces.name: delivery-manifest

report_ref.meaning: Equals artifact_ref of the single files entry with role report

gate_decision_refs.meaning: Gate decisions that advanced the run

artifact_refs.meaning: Every lifecycle record: candidate_set, screening_result, opportunity_card, hypothesis_blueprint, poc_manifest, benchmark_payload, evaluation_verdict

files.meaning: Every exported file with role and audience; unique path

missing_evidence.meaning: Omissions and redactions; blocking item blocks release

interfaces.failure: Hash mismatch, missing role, contradiction with verdict or blocking missing evidence blocks release/export

interfaces.name: research-report

sections.meaning: Title line then nine level-2 sections in fixed order: 1. Objective; 2. Opportunity and citations; 3. Hypothesis and registered criteria; 4. Method and POC; 5. Results: baseline vs treatment; 6. Scientific verdict and reasoning; 7. Limitations and risks; 8. Follow-up recommendations; 9. Reproducibility. Structure and per-section content are defined in capsules/delivery.md#research_report

interfaces.failure: Missing or misordered section, verdict mismatch, number mismatch or unlabeled recommendation is rejected by host checks

path.meaning: Confined lowercase relative path, unique in manifest

artifact_ref.meaning: Exact content identity; sha256 equals file bytes

contract_index_rows: | delivery_manifest | delivery-manifest:field-contract:2 | Delivery CC | user, checking, client | [delivery.md](capsules/delivery.md#delivery_manifest) |
| research_report | research-report:field-contract:1 | Delivery CC | user, checking, client | [delivery.md](capsules/delivery.md#research_report) |
prd_conflicts: PRD names Research_Brief.json, Benchmark_Payload.json, Evaluation_Verdict.json and the capability file report_capsule.md; internal names are lowercase research_brief.json, benchmark_payload.json, evaluation_verdict.json and research.delivery (capsule README naming rules). Report file is lowercase research_report.md unless the user names another file.
PRD 3.9.2 lists proposals, roadmaps, papers, posters and visualizations as possible deliverables; M1 locks one static markdown template (PRD 3.9.1 and 3.9.2 blacklist). Variants are a future seam.
PRD M1_Final_Test_Report.md, Phase completion reports and M1_Implementation_Report.md are implementation process documents, not Delivery CC outputs.
PRD 3.9.4 (send to workspace, show in UI, close /swarmflows run) is lifecycle closure done by the host after the gate, not by the CC.
open_questions: Audience enum is researcher and reviewer only; PRD owner to confirm no other audience is needed in M1.
The synthetic example run has one gate decision; the "every gate decision of the run" check needs the run record to be exercised for real.
Invalid report .md files are validated through their manifests by the host section checks; validate.py needs a markdown report section check to exercise them (not present).
Port gate_decision carries one or more artifacts; run plan owner to confirm multi-artifact ports are allowed.
